prompt: TaskBoard is a collaboration to-do app with auth, items list, and profile settings.
specRaw:
S1: Signing up with a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters creates the account and lands the user on the dashboard.
S2: Signing up with an invalid email address (for example "not-an-email") is rejected with the message "Enter a valid email address".
S3: Signing up with a password shorter than 8 characters is rejected with the message "Password must be at least 8 characters".
S4: Logging in with a correct email and password lands the user on the dashboard.
S5: Logging in with a wrong password shows the message "Invalid email or password" and the user stays on the login page.
S6: Logging in is case-insensitive for the email address (QA.Tester@Example.com works the same as qa.tester@example.com).
S7: On the dashboard, adding an item with a non-empty title shows that item in the list.
S8: On the dashboard, adding an item with an empty title is rejected with the message "Title is required" and no item is added.
S9: With several items in the list, clicking Delete on an item removes only that item.
S10: On the settings page, saving a display name shows "Settings saved" every time, and the page loads without console errors.
S11: Logging out returns the user to the login page, and pressing the browser Back button afterwards does not show the dashboard.

spec.text: Signing up with a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters creates the account and lands the user on the dashboard.
Signing up with an invalid email address (for example "not-an-email") is rejected with the message "Enter a valid email address".
Signing up with a password shorter than 8 characters is rejected with the message "Password must be at least 8 characters".
Logging in with a correct email and password lands the user on the dashboard.
Logging in with a wrong password shows the message "Invalid email or password" and the user stays on the login page.
Logging in is case-insensitive for the email address (QA.Tester@Example.com works the same as qa.tester@example.com).
On the dashboard, adding an item with a non-empty title shows that item in the list.
On the dashboard, adding an item with an empty title is rejected with the message "Title is required" and no item is added.
With several items in the list, clicking Delete on an item removes only that item.
On the settings page, saving a display name shows "Settings saved" every time, and the page loads without console errors.
Logging out returns the user to the login page, and pressing the browser Back button afterwards does not show the dashboard.
